questions.stem: A 5-year-old child presents with symptoms of fever, headache, vomiting, and altered mental status. Cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) analysis reveals lymphocytic pleocytosis, elevated protein levels, and decreased glucose levels. Acid-fast bacilli staining of the CSF is negative, but polymerase chain reaction (PCR) testing detects Mycobacterium tuberculosis DNA. Which of the following additional CSF findings is most likely to support the diagnosis of tubercular meningitis (TBM) in this child?
